AND T1.FINPROD_ID in
null) OR T1.FINPROD_ID in (

UNION ALL SELECT T1.CASH_ID CASH_ID, T1.EFF_DATE EFF_DATE, T1.INT_TYPE INT_TYPE, T1.BASIS BASIS, T1.RESET_TYPE RESET_TYPE, T1.RESET_FREQ RESET_FREQ, T1.FIRST_RESET_DATE FIRST_RESET_DATE, T1.RESET_DATE RESET_DATE, T1.OBSERVE_BEF_DAY OBSERVE_BEF_DAY, T1.OBSERVE_BEF_UNIT OBSERVE_BEF_UNIT, T1.RATE RATE, T1.COEFFICIENT COEFFICIENT, T1.SPREAD_RATE SPREAD_RATE, T1.HIGHEST_RATE HIGHEST_RATE, T1.LOWEST_RATE LOWEST_RATE, T1.BENCHMARK_ID BENCHMARK_ID, T1.BENCHMARK_TYPE BENCHMARK_TYPE, T1.FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, T1.BRANCH BRANCH, T1.FINPROD_TYPE FINPROD_TYPE, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 FINPROD_TYPE2, T1.FIRST_CONFIRM_DATE FIRST_CONFIRM_DATE, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM FIN_RATE_INFO T1, (SELECT T2.CASH_ID, MAX(T2.EFF_DATE) EFF_DATE FROM FIN_RATE_INFO T2 WHERE T2.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T2.INT_TYPE = #{rateType02} GROUP BY T2.CASH_ID) T3, STL_CAPACCT_INFO T4 WHERE T1.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T1.EFF_DATE = T3.EFF_DATE AND T1.CASH_ID = T3.CASH_ID AND T1.INT_TYPE = #{rateType02} AND T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.ACCT_NO

SELECT T1.OBJECT_ID OBJECT_ID, T1.S_INFO_WINDCODE S_INFO_WINDCODE, T1.CHANGE_DT CHANGE_DT, T1.RATE RATE, T1.OPDATE OPDATE, T1.OPMODE OPMODE FROM INTERF_FLOATINGCOUPONSRATE T1,FIN_PRODUCT T2 WHERE T1.S_INFO_WINDCODE = T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND T2.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND T1.CHANGE_DT = #{sysDate}

SELECT INT_RATE_ID INT_RATE_ID, INT_RATE_TYPE INT_RATE_TYPE, EFF_DATE EFF_DATE, RELAESE_DATE RELAESE_DATE, INT_RATE INT_RATE, CCY CCY, INPUT_TYPE INPUT_TYPE FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO WHERE EFF_DATE = TO_DATE(#{effDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND INT_RATE_ID = #{intRateId}

SELECT T1.INT_RATE_ID INT_RATE_ID, T1.INT_RATE_TYPE INT_RATE_TYPE, T1.EFF_DATE EFF_DATE, T1.RELAESE_DATE RELAESE_DATE, T1.INT_RATE INT_RATE, T1.CCY CCY, T1.INPUT_TYPE INPUT_TYPE FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO T1, ( SELECT max( T2.EFF_DATE ) EFF_DATE, T2.INT_RATE_ID FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO T2 WHERE T2.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY T2.INT_RATE_ID ) T3 WHERE T1.EFF_DATE = T3.EFF_DATE AND T1.INT_RATE_ID = T3.INT_RATE_ID AND T1.INT_RATE_ID = #{intRateId}
